When Doublade evolves once more, it remains two bodies, but the two blades merge together to form a larger, more regal one. The sheath meanwhile is now too small for the blade and so turns into a shield fit on the arm-like tassels. Legends say that it’s able to detect innate leadership, and can make people destined to become king. This is not entirely incorrect, but rather than being a great judge of character, Aegislash is highly manipulative. It’ll find a victim that has qualities of leadership enough for it to bring the victim into a high position of power, then once their ward is at a satisfactory level of political power, it’ll show its true colors. Many ancient kingdoms have fallen due to Aegislash.
